title: Residue classification of two fixed time templates and bounded missed-class diagnostics
status: Frozen before new classification and diagnostic calculations; prior13/16 outcomes and simple residue expectations inform the design

family.V_domain: positive integers outside{1,4,5,6,7,11}; eight distinct speeds
family.phase_scope: Only11 may have initial phase theta; theta0 is common-start

classification.period: 120=lcm(8,15), sufficient coefficient/classification period; no minimal-period claim
outputs: exact unchanged distance vectors at both times
prove whether best-of-pair full margin is constant in theta, not merely its infimum
exact failed residue classes and least positive admissible representative per class
classification.rule: Use only fixed-time substitutions and exact circle inequalities; no full allowed set may choose or tune the templates

diagnostics.selection_rule: After classification, choose the least positive admissible V in each residue class where the union of the four fixed times fails the1/8 threshold. If more than six classes fail, stop diagnostics and report the classification; do not silently broaden.
permitted_outputs: complete unchanged-safe closed time set A
full phase projection P under11t mod1, including isolated points
bulk support B, maximum gaps and minimum containing arc lengths
all-phase nonemptiness/positive-duration decisions via supplied covering criteria
complete common-start allowed set; direct witness chosen as midpoint of longest positive component, earliest tie; otherwise earliest isolated point
diagnostics.limits: At most six fixed representatives; no new-template search, phase grid, multiplicity profile, all-reference scan, or search over other speeds. Projection diagnostics do not claim a cheap arithmetic selection rule.

review: independent classification through direct exact phase-envelope or safe-arc geometry, not importing primary code
independent diagnostic reconstruction through a different time-set method and direct branch checks
review all-phase versus common-start quantifiers, equality, template failure versus actual infeasibility, and unbounded residue argument
compare existing common-start family coverage and the new small-gcd priority; identify actual remaining scope
general_deductions: Supplied algebraic or geometric consequences within these fixed templates are permitted and remain proof candidates. No new parameter family or extra control list is implicitly authorized.
limits: No broad speed search, extra phases sampled on a grid, extra time-template search, outside messages, paid compute, novelty claim, main merge, or silent promotion of proof candidates. Keep+7/+9 parked.
